question: Will a shared digital fetch queue reduce handoff ambiguity in a milking workflow?

prediction.statement: A shared queue will reduce ambiguous handoffs compared with a handwritten list.
falsifiers: The queue creates equal or more ambiguous handoffs during the pilot.
Workers cannot reliably access or update the queue during normal work.

action.description: Run a reversible one-shift synthetic pilot with a shared queue.

stop_rule.description: Stop after one pilot shift or immediately if the workflow adds safety risk.

provenance.note: Synthetic demonstration only; not evidence from a real farm.
